set system host-name PE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols ptp interface all.explanation: Configure the interface for the PTP protocol.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface used in the PTP protocol, e.g. g-1/0/0.0.

set protocols ptp clock-source bits1 inp.command: set protocols ptp clock-source bits1 input-type 1pps
set protocols ptp clock-source bits1 inp.explanation: 配置PTP时钟源的输入类型。

parameters.name: clock-source
parameters.explanation: 时钟源名称。

parameters.name: input-type
parameters.explanation: 时钟源的输入类型，例如1pps。

set protocols ptp clock-source bits1 pri.command: set protocols ptp clock-source bits1 priority 2

parameters.name: clock-source
parameters.explanation: 时钟源名称。

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: 时钟源的优先级，数值越小优先级越高。

set protocols ptp domain 1.explanation: Configures the domain number of the PTP protocol.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.explanation: The PTP protocol domain number, which distinguishes between different PTP domains.

set protocols ptp device-type boundary-c.explanation: 配置PTP设备类型为边界时钟。

parameters.name: device-type
parameters.explanation: PTP设备类型，例如boundary-clock。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0.explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: OSPF area ID.

interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.
